cards.answer: Azir is a mage and marksman who fights through Sand Soldiers whose attacks deal magic damage in a line. His soldier damage scales with AP, and he can dash to a soldier or push enemies back with a charging wall.
cards.counterplay: Move away from soldier attack lines and watch his soldier positions before closing in.

cards.answer: Azir can build a temporary Sun Disc turret on destroyed turret ruins outside the enemy base. It loses health over time and loses defenses when Azir dies or moves too far away.
cards.counterplay: Respect the rebuilt turret and look for pressure when Azir leaves it.

cards.answer: Conquering Sands sends all active Sand Soldiers toward a location, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies they pass through or strike on arrival. Being hit by additional soldiers does not add damage or slow.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the soldiers' movement and reassess their attack positions after they move.

citations.quote: Azir orders all Sand Soldiers to dash toward the target location, dealing magic damage to all enemies they pass through as well as those in front of them upon arrival, and slowing them by 25% for 1 second.

facts.claim: Conquering Sands sends all active Sand Soldiers toward a location, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies they pass through or strike on arrival.

facts.claim: Being hit by additional soldiers does not add damage or slow.

cards.priority_reason: Repositions his damage zones while applying a slow.

cards.answer: Arise! summons an untargetable Sand Soldier that attacks in Azir's place against targets in its range, dealing magic damage in a line. Soldiers expire faster near enemy turrets and disappear if Azir moves too far away.
cards.counterplay: Move out of soldier reach and avoid lining up with their attack targets.

cards.answer: Shifting Sands shields Azir and dashes him toward a Sand Soldier, dealing magic damage along his path. Hitting an enemy champion stops his dash and gives him a soldier charge. His dash follows the soldier if Conquering Sands moves it.
cards.counterplay: Watch the soldier destination and allow for it to move during his dash.

cards.answer: Emperor's Divide sends a wall of soldiers charging forward, dealing magic damage and knocking enemies back. The soldiers then remain as terrain that blocks enemies while Azir and his allies can pass through.
cards.counterplay: Watch his facing when approaching and keep an escape route around the wall.
